==================
varnish with vcl+backend, options, continuation and expect
==================

varnishtest "Check that a cache fetch + hit transaction works"

varnish v1 -arg "-p thread_pool_min=2" \
	-vcl+backend { } -start

varnish v1 -vcl {
	backend default { .host = "${bad_ip}"; }
	sub vcl_recv { if (std.port(server.ip) == ${s1_port}) { } }
} -start

varnish v2 -syntax 4.0 -errvcl {Compiled VCL version (4.0) not supported.} {
	backend b None;
}
varnish v1 -errvcl "VCL compilation failed" "backend be none;"
varnish v1 -cliok "param.set feature +http2"
varnish v1 -cliok {ban req.url ~ "BAR"}
varnish v1 -clierr 106 "param.set default_ttl -1"
varnish v1 -expect sess_conn == 2
varnish v1 -expect !MAIN.n_object

==================
global commands
==================

feature !workspace_emulator ipv6
feature cmd {haproxy --version 2>&1 | grep -q 'HA-*Proxy version'}
delay .2
setenv -ifunset FOO ${tmpdir}/foo
setenv BAR "bar baz"
barrier b1 cond 2 -cyclic
barrier b2 sock 3
shell "echo 'vcl 4.0;' > ${tmpdir}/_b00014.vcl"
shell -err -expect {Usage: varnishadm} \
	"varnishadm -h"
shell -match {^[	 ]*0\b} "wc -c ${tmpdir}/p1/stderr"
shell -exit 1 -expect {varnishtest [options]} {varnishtest -h}
shell {
	cat >${tmpdir}/f <<-EOF
	x = { y = 1; }
	EOF
} -run
process p1 -winsz 100 200 {exec varnishlog -n ${v1_name} -g raw} -start
process p1 "mkfs.mse -c ${tmpdir}/mse.conf" -expect-exit 0x1 -run
process p1 -expect-text 0 0 "to launch" -writeln "q" -wait
filewrite -a ${tmpdir}/foo "content"
include ${tmpdir}/other.vtc
vsm m1 -n ${v1_name} -attach
loop 3 {
	delay 1
}
loop 4 rxdata

==================
server and client blocks
==================

server s1 -repeat 2 -listen "${tmpdir}/sock" {
	rxreq
	expect req.url == /foo
	expect req.http.host == <undef>
	expect req.url == {/'}
	non_fatal
	txresp -status 200 -hdr "Content-Type: text/plain" \
		-hdr content-length "23" -bodylen 8
	chunkedlen 10
	sendhex "1f 8b 08"
	close
	accept
	timeout 10
	expect_close
} -start

server s2 "" -start

client c1 -connect ${s1_sock} -proxy2 "${v1_addr}:1 2.2.2.2:2" {
	txreq -req POST -url "/" -hdr "Host: foo" -body {{"json": 1}}
	rxresp
	expect resp.status == 200
	expect resp.http.t1 -gt resp.http.t0
	expect resp.body ~ "^abc"
	barrier b1 sync
	send "raw bytes"
	recv 20
	gunzip
	txreq -url ${string,repeat,4,/123456789}
} -run

client c1 {
	tls_config {
		servername = example.com
		pem-file = "${topsrc}/etc/ca/bundle/example.com.pem"
	}
	tls_handshake
} -run

==================
h2 streams
==================

client c1 {
	stream 0 rxsettings -run
	stream 1 -wait { txresp } -run
	stream next {
		txreq -url /foo \
			-hdr :scheme http
		rxresp
		expect resp.status == 200
		txdata -data "x" -nostrend
		rxrst
		expect rst.err == ENHANCE_YOUR_CALM
	} -run
} -run

==================
logexpect, haproxy, syslog, tunnel
==================

logexpect l1 -v v1 -g vxid -q {ReqURL ~ "^/2"} -d 1 {
	expect * 1001 ReqURL /foo
	expect 0 = Begin
	fail add * ReqHeader "x"
	fail clear
	loop 2 {
		expect * * VCL_call
	}
	abort
} -start

logexpect l1 -wait

haproxy h1 -conf {
	defaults
		mode http
} -start

haproxy h1 -cli {
	send "show info"
	expect ~ "Name: HAProxy"
}

syslog S1 -level notice {
	recv
	expect ~ "foo"
} -start

tunnel t1 -start+pause -connect "${s1_sock}" {
	pause
	send 10
	recv 20
	resume
} -start
